name: dmx-artnet
description: DMX-512 I/O over Art-Net + sACN (E1.31). Inbound listeners translate channel changes into Director commands via IPluginContext::enqueueCommand; outbound sender emits DMX from SetDmxOut commands and engine-internal DmxFrame bus messages. Also supports Enttec DMX-USB-Pro hardware on Windows. Default mappings live in the plugin; per-project mapping tables come from the active .entity file (schema v22+).
